coreMemory.english: v. to continue, retain, or cause something to remain in a state；v. cause to continue in a certain state, position, or activity
coreMemory.structure: keep doing something /ˈkiːp ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（继续做某事）；keep something safe /ˈkiːp ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈseɪf/（保护好某物）；keep in mind /ˈkiːp ɪn ˈmaɪnd/（记住；牢记）；keep someone from doing something /ˈkiːp ˈsʌˌmwʌn ˈfrʌm ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（阻止某人做某事）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ keep to do something → ✅ keep doing something；❌ keep someone doing something → ✅ keep someone from doing something

commonErrors.note: “keep doing something”是需要动词 -ing 形式的固定结构；doing 是占位符，应换成具体动词的 -ing 形式。
在“keep someone from doing something”这个常用搭配中，介词 from 负责连接后面的对象或范围，不能省略或随意换成其他介词。

coreMemory.example: Keep practicing even when a word feels difficult.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 即使某个词很难，也要继续练习。

synonyms.difference: retain 侧重“保留；保持”。对应的常用英文义是 “to continue, retain, or cause something to remain in a state”。keep 在本卡搭配“keep doing something”中表达“保持”；换词时要同时检查宾语和介词。

antonyms.usage: 在“保持”这个义项下，discard（丢弃；放弃）与 keep 形成对比。对应的常用英文义是 “opposite of keep”。只在这个明确义项和句型中对比，不把两个词的所有用法都视为相反。

derivatives.note: 可指负责看守的人或值得留下的东西。
